title: The Puddle Boots and a Second Pair
youtube_title: The Puddle Boots and a Second Pair | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Making room at the table is a kind of abundance.
summary: At a ferry bench with a folded blanket, Vera sees that a second pair of puddle boots by the door will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Vera makes a smaller, even share so Uma is included, and Miss Dalca lets the choice stand without a speech.
